content: Chepa ngwilikiho kubhatyekela kulinga utangwo aghu kwa bhandu bha Chapanga bha akwo Yudea.

Kiyaha nungumanya mummeghite na kilyakalyaka kya kutangatila, na nenga nungulidumbila kwakya nnando aghwo kwa bhandu bha akwo Mekadonia. Nikiaghombela, “Alongo bhetu bha ku Akaya abhegha kala kutandila ngungwa yiipitite.” Habhu, mwoyo ghwa mwenga ghubhatenda atangalo abheghe na mwoyo ghwa kubhuha.
Hinu, nubhalaghila alongo bhetu abho, ngati kuliloka kwa twenga kukotoke kubhonekana kwa malagho ghweka, ngati mmonekane mmegha kala na mmegha na hilibhi hya kutangatila handa panongelite.

Yikotoke kubhegha kukita bhandu bha ku Mekodonia paapala kuhika papamu na nenga tutabhabhona mmegha kala ng'obhe, apo twenga twapata honi kyangakambuka honi yamuyimokola mwenga kiyaha tubhahyubhalila kyanalumu.

Kya habhu, mona yibhegha mbaha kubhayupa abha alongo alongolele kuhika kwa mwenga, amokole kuyibhika kala hupo yenu yimuyilaghite ngati ibhonehe hoto kukita ndo hupo yiibhuhitwe kwa mapalo na chepa kwa kukikinihwa.
Nkulungwe, “Ywakapanda mbeyu hyamandina kaabena hyamandina, ywakapanda mbeyu ndangalo kaabena kwa utangalo.”
Kila mundu kabhuhe handa pakapalite mu mwoyo ghwake na chepa kwa kihyongololo ebu kwa kukikinihwa, kiyaha Chapanga kangunpala mundu ywakabhuha kwa uyelelo.

Chapanga kanguhotola kubhapegha kuchweha kwa ghala ghamughapala, mmokole kubhegha na hilibhi hyoha himuhipala mu manjubha ghoha, na habhu nchwehe kutangatila milando mitangalo mukila lihengo lya maha.

content.text: “Ywombe kangubhuha kwa mwoyo ghwa utekulo na kanguapegha kapukwa,
umaha ghwake ghwahighala mumanjubha ghoha kyangali uhiko.”

content: Chapanga ywakanpeha nkulima mbeyu kwakya kupanda, na lingate kwakya hilyo, katabhapegha na mwenga bhubho mbeyu, na katayitenda yimele, yikule na kubhapegha mabeno matangalo kubhukana na kubhuha kwenu kwa bhandu.
Ywombe kataatenda mmeghe atopelo kwa kila kilibhi mumanjubha ghoha, ngati bhandu amokole kunnumba Chapanga kwakya hupo hyenu hyahikingama kuhuma kwa twenga.
Kiyaha lihengo ali limulitenda, hangi chepa lyabhatangatila bhandu bha Chapanga ghweka, ghati bhubho lyabhatenda bhandu atangalo bhannumbe Chapanga.

Kubhukana na ghala ghanakubhonekana mulihengo lyetu ali, bhandu bhatanpegha ukulu Chapanga kiyaha ya mwenga kuhyubhalila Nhalo ghwa Maha ghwa Kilisto ghumughulandamiha muulongolo ghwa bhandu, na hila hila kwa mwoyo ghwenu ghwa kupala kuapegha bhandu bhoha hilibhi hyenu.
Habhu, bhataayupila mwenga kwa mwoyo ghumu kwakya umaha ghwa Chapanga ghwakaapeghite Chapanga.
Tunnumbe Chapanga kwakya hupo hyake, hyene hyangahotoleka kulubhulila.
